resources.string: A-B loop
Adds an option to loop part of a song by long-pressing the seekbar to set loop start and end points.
Accessibility layout
Enables physical keyboard simulator and accessibility keyboard layout mode.
Advanced & Gemini voice typing
Enables Gemini Rambler natural voice typing, NGA consolidated speech dictation, and Bluetooth microphone settings.
AI Writing Tools & Flow mode
Enables AI Writing Tools (proofread, rewrite, smart edit) and llm_pc flow-mode keys for every language.
Allow screenshots
Clears FLAG_SECURE so screenshots and screen recordings work everywhere, including disappearing media.
Always show compass
Keeps the compass needle and bearing indicator permanently visible on the map instead of automatically hiding when facing North.
Always show Hide
Adds an option to always show Hide in the menu of feed posts, even when replaced by recommendations.
Ambient mode
Forces Ambient mode on and adds options to bypass power saving restrictions
AMOLED black theme
Applies pure AMOLED black backgrounds to Google Maps dark mode interface elements.
AMOLED dark theme

Applies a pure AMOLED pitch black theme (#000000) throughout YouTube interface elements, feed, cards, watch view, and menus. Ambient mode must be disabled in YouTube\'s video player settings (or via the Ambient mode patch) for true pitch black during video playback.
Android Auto
Enables YouTube Music integration and browsing in Android Auto head units.
Anonymous profile viewing
Visits user profiles without appearing in \'Who viewed your profile\'.
Apple Music artwork
Replaces standard album artwork with animated high-resolution Apple Music artwork.
Auto captions
Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled.
Autoplay control
Adds a player button and a rule for the next video: playlists and queues go on, a Mix stops after a number of videos, a suggested video never plays.
Backup & Restore settings
Enables Gboard personal dictionary, preferences, and custom theme backup and restore options.
Block AutoMod comments
Hides stickied and automated comments from u/AutoModerator at the top of comment threads.
Block popup ads
Blocks fullscreen promotions ("Pendragon" messages) shown when opening the app.
Block screenshot detection
Stops Instagram from notifying people when you take screenshots or screen recordings.
Block Telemetry & Trackers
Redirects Braze, Sentry, Google Ads, Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics endpoints
Block tracking

Block Update Screen
Blocks the outdated app screen and suppresses in-app update prompts on launch.
Bypass image region restrictions
Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images

Captions in picture-in-picture
Adds an option to show captions in picture-in-picture mode.
Change start page
Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.
Channel search
Adds an option to search inside the channel that is currently open instead of searching all of YouTube.
Channel whitelist
Adds options to allow whitelisting specific channels to show ads or override playback speeds.
Collapse all comments
Adds an option to show a button next to the comment count of a post that collapses or expands all comments.
Colorize comment indent lines
Replaces the default gray comment indent lines with color-coded lines.

Hooks the command router of each activity so the extension can run commands.

Prevents automatic scrolling to the next video in immersive view.
conversionContextPatch
Hooks the method to use the conversion context in an extension.
Copy text
Long press a post, comment, or any text to select and copy it in place or in a sheet.
Copy video link
Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links.
Cursor trackpad
Enables free-cursor mode: slide on the spacebar to move the text cursor.
Custom seekbar thumb
Adds an option to customize the seekbar thumb with a custom image or animated GIF.
Custom sharing domain
Rewrites shared x.com and twitter.com links to fxtwitter.com for rich video and photo embeds in Discord and Telegram.
Customize navigation bar
Removes selected bottom navigation tabs (My Network, Post, Notifications, Jobs, Video, News) while keeping at least 3 tabs.
DeArrow
Adds options to replace video thumbnails and titles using the DeArrow API,
Developer options & internal flags
Unlocks Gboard\'s internal developer options and experimental feature flag menus in settings.
Diagnose Spotify client

Direct chat bubbles
Allows Instagram direct message notifications to open as floating Android chat bubbles.
Disable ad breaks
Disables the ad slots that play ads between songs. Experimental.
Disable analytics

Disable audio ducking

Disable bottom bar auto-hide
Adds an option to keep the bottom navigation bar visible while scrolling.
Disable chapter skip double tap
Adds an option to disable chapter skipping when double-tapping with two fingers.
Disable dislike redirection
Prevents skipping to the next track when tapping the dislike button.
Disable double-tap like
Stops a double tap on a feed post from liking it.
Disable DRC audio
Adds options to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio and loudness normalization.

Disables the full-screen vertical swipe video player in explore and timelines.

Disables the modern home UI on supported Reddit versions.

Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video.
Disable Reddit home feed auto-refresh
Stops the home feed from refreshing automatically after viewing a post or being away.
Disable Reddit home screen redirect
Stops Reddit from redirecting to the home screen when the app resumes from the background.

Disables the banner that shows up after taking a screenshot.
Disable refresh on back to exit
Adds an option to exit the app with back on the home feed without first scrolling to the top and reloading.
Disable Shorts resuming on startup
Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched.
Disable SSL pinning
Bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning on Cloudflare API calls to allow TLS traffic inspection.
Disable telemetry
Disables Cloudflare analytics and Firebase telemetry event dispatchers.
Disable timeline auto-refresh
Stops the home timeline from refreshing and jumping to the top automatically, and preserves timeline position on startup.
Disable video codecs
Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs.
DM Debloat
Hides call buttons in direct message conversations (disables outgoing DM calls).
Don\'t save recent searches
Prevents searches from being added to your recent search history.
Don\'t send reel watch history
Stops Instagram from sending watched reel status to its servers, keeping your watch history private.
Download all from gallery
Adds an option to download all media items from a gallery post at once.
Download media
Adds download options to the menus of posts, reels and stories, and to profile pictures.
Downloads
Enables download action buttons and offline audio caching.
Emoji Palette V2 & size slider
Enables the redesigned emoji drawer layout with frequent/recent tabs and the emoji size slider.
Enable DCIM folders backup control
Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing you to control backup
Enable debugging
Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.
Enable exclusive audio playback
Enables the option to play audio without video.
Enable Picture-in-Picture
Enables Crunchyroll\'s native Picture-in-Picture with contextual skip intro and skip credits controls.
Enable speedometer & speed limits
Forces the real-time driving speedometer and speed limit indicators to be permanently enabled and visible regardless of country or regional restrictions.
Expand posts
Shows posts fully expanded by default without having to tap \'...see more\'.
Extended clipboard & screenshot chips
Enables 20,000-char clipboard items, retention slider (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, Never), and floating screenshot suggestion chips.
ExtensionHook
Feed filters
Filters celebrations, job cards, reposts, videos, reaction counts, AI coach prompts, puzzle games, recommendations, and new posts pills.
Filter Discover ads
Filters promoted ad cards from the Google Discover feed.
Fix third party launchers widgets
Allows the Spotify widgets to be added to third party launchers.
Force original audio
Adds an option to always use the original audio track.
Force system font
Forces Reddit to use the Android system font instead of custom bundled fonts.
Force zoom buttons
Forces dedicated zoom in and zoom out (+/-) buttons to always appear on map screens for easier one-handed navigation.
Full-screen reply
Opens comment replies in the full-screen editor instead of the inline composer.
Fullscreen playlist panel
Adds an option to show the playlist panel over the fullscreen player on tablets, instead of exiting fullscreen.
G Logo on Spacebar
Renders the Google G logo icon on the spacebar with clean keycap centering.
Ghost mode: hide typing indicator
Stops LinkedIn from sending the "typing..." state to the other person.
Ghost mode: no read receipts
Keeps conversations unread on the other side while you are chatting.
Glass menus
Adds an option to show menus as frosted glass with blurred backgrounds on Android 12+.
Glass navigation bar
Shows the Reddit bottom navigation bar, or tablet side rail, as a floating translucent glass capsule.
Google Sans Flex typography
Enables Google Sans Flex keycap font styling and GM3 expressive design.
Grammar & spell checker chips
Enables Gboard\'s on-device grammar checker and modern inline spell checker suggestion chips on Android 12+.
Hide ad sections
Removes brand ad sections from the home, search and now playing pages.
Hide ad views
Hides ad banners, display ads, premium upsell cards, and promotional nudges.
Hide ads
Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.
Hide Ask button
Adds an option to hide the Ask AI button from the toolbar.

Hides Gemini AI summaries, Ask Maps navigation entrypoints, promotional sign-in prompts, and place sheet clutter.
Hide communities shelf
Hides related or suggested communities shelves in subreddits.
Hide context menu upsells
Removes "Premium" entries from the context menus of songs, albums and playlists.
Hide feed ads
Removes promoted posts from the feed, in the server-driven and legacy lists.
Hide Follow on feed posts
Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off feed posts, keeping the post header clean.
Hide Follow on stories
Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don\'t follow. The name, time and menu stay.
Hide Grok
Hides Grok tab, drawer entry, and related AI shortcuts.
Hide incognito icon
Replaces the incognito mask/glasses icon in the toolbar with the standard access point icon while keeping incognito mode active.
Hide info cards
Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.
Hide interactive posts
Hides game and other interactive app posts from the home feed and other recommended feeds.
Hide layout components
Adds options to hide general layout components.
Hide Meta AI
Removes Meta AI search suggestions, feed units, and chat integration.
Hide mod queue auto-enforce banner

Hide navigation bar labels
Hides text labels under the bottom navigation icons.
Hide People also search for section
Adds an option to hide the \'People also search for\' section from search results.
Hide playlist ads
Removes ads embedded into playlists.
Hide post buttons
Adds options to hide post action bar buttons (upvote, downvote, comment, share, award).

Removes the "Premium" tab from the bottom navigation bar.

Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the Me panel.
Hide promoted jobs
Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.
Hide Reddit ads
Hides promoted posts, comment ads and their placeholders.

Hides selected buttons (Games, Answers, Chat, Communities, Create) from Reddit\'s navigation bar.

Makes the post view-count getter report nothing so the views indicator is empty.

Stubs the score getters so upvote counts report zero or hidden.
Hide reels ads
Suppresses sponsored reels in the Reels tab and viewer.
Hide Related Posts section
Hides the related posts section in post details.
Hide search answers preview
Hides the Reddit Answers preview section at the top of search results.
Hide seekbar
Adds an option to hide the seekbar.
Hide Shorts components
Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.
Hide sponsored messages
Removes sponsored InMail conversations from the messaging list.
Hide status bar
Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment.
Hide story rings outside stories tray
Hides unread story rings from profile pictures across posts, comments, reels, and profiles, keeping them only in the top stories row.
Hide suggested posts
Removes suggested posts, recommended accounts, and explore chaining suggestions from the feed.
Hide Timeline Bookmarks
Hides the inline bookmark button from tweet action bars in the timeline.
Hide timestamp
Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.
Hide Trending shelves
Hides trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.
Hide typing status
Stops people you are chatting with from seeing when you are typing in direct messages.
Hide upgrade button
Hides the upgrade tab from the pivot bar.
Hide upgrade promotions
Hides upgrade dialogs, onboarding prompts, and account upgrade banners.
Hide video action buttons
Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.
Hide video ads
Disables the video ad plugin of the now playing view.
Hide videos for you
Hides the "Videos for you" or video carousel recommendation section between feed posts.
High quality avatars
Shows user avatars in full resolution instead of the downscaled preview.
High refresh rate
Removes Google Maps\' 60 Hz window cap and unlocks 90 Hz / 120 Hz display refresh rate and map rendering.
Hold gesture
Adds options to change the playback speed, to keep it and to run actions by dragging after tapping and holding the video player.
Home feed tabs
Enables options to customize or hide home feed tabs like Latest, Popular, and Watch.
Keep feed on reopen
Keeps your place in the feed when you return to LinkedIn instead of reloading it.
Keep media viewer in subreddit
Keeps the media viewer within the current subreddit when swiping between posts.
Keep screen awake
Prevents the screen from dimming or turning off during active navigation and map exploration.
Keypress vibration intensity control
Enables hardware VibrationEffect vibration strength and intensity slider on Android 11+.
LegacyPlayerControls
Manages the code for the player controls of the YouTube player.

Enables video seeking on live streams that have disabled DVR (Digital Video Recorder).
Manual Incognito mode toggle
Adds a manual Incognito mode toggle button in Gboard\'s toolbar access points.
Material You theme
Applies dynamic wallpaper colors to LinkedIn accents and card backgrounds on Android 12+.
Media viewer black background
Uses pure AMOLED black for the media viewer background instead of dark gray.
Miniplayer
Adds options to change the in-app minimized player.
Mute audio ads
Mutes the music stream while an audio ad plays and restores the volume afterwards.
Navigation bar
Adds options to configure the bottom navigation bar (including floating Glass navigation bar with custom size/opacity, animated tabs, and hiding buttons) and toolbar.
On-the-go player
Adds an option to open a panel with large playback controls from the On-the-go item of the video player menu.
Open links directly
Opens external links without LinkedIn\'s safety/go warning page.

Opens web links directly in your default browser instead of Instagram\'s in-app browser. Instagram pages and links opened for an ad stay in the app.

Opens external links without going through the out.reddit.com redirector.

Always opens links in your default external web browser instead of Reddit\'s in-app Custom Tabs browser.
Open system share sheet
Opens the Android system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet when sharing songs, playlists, or artists.
Pause Search Suggestions
Stops persisting search suggestions locally without breaking search.
Pause when muted
Adds an option to pause playback automatically when volume is lowered to zero.

Adds rewind and forward (±5 seconds) buttons to the Picture-in-picture window.
Pitch black theme
Replaces the dark mode gray backgrounds with pure AMOLED pitch black (#000000).
Play album songs
Adds an option to play the songs of albums instead of their music videos.
Play Redgifs with audio
Plays original Redgifs video with audio instead of Reddit\'s silent copy.
Playback speed
Adds options to customize and fine-tune playback speed for songs and music videos.
PlayerControlsOverlayVisibility
PlayerResponseMethodHook

Hook to get the current player type and video playback state.
Playlist button
Adds an option to display a button in the video player that opens the playlist panel.
Playlist search
Adds a button to playlist pages to search the videos of that playlist.
Playlist track tap
Adds options to customize playback behavior when tapping individual tracks in playlists.
Plus UI badge
Displays Plus plan UI indicators.
Post menu items

Adds an option to choose whether private browsing uses Anonymous Browsing or Incognito.
Queue like filter
Adds an option to automatically filter disliked tracks from the upcoming playback queue.
Quick insert
Enables Gboard\'s super-insert (quick insert) suggestions row with dynamic multi-view.
Quick, Magic & GenAI Emoji
Enables the fast-access emoji bar, Gemini Magic Emoji, and Emogen GenAI emoji maker.
Reddit Settings
Adds Morphe settings into Reddit\'s settings menu.

Plays HD Redgifs video if available. HD videos are larger and may load slower.
Remember collapsed comments
Keeps comments you collapsed collapsed when reopening a post.
Remember repeat state
Preserves repeat playback preferences across app restarts.
Remember shuffle state
Preserves shuffle playback preferences across app restarts.
Remember video quality
Remembers the last selected video quality and applies default quality on Wi-Fi and mobile networks.
Remove Ads
Removes promoted posts, trends, and ads from timeline feeds.
Remove background playback restrictions
Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.
Remove build expired popup
Stops Instagram from locking you out with an update screen stating that the app build has expired.
Remove from Continue Watching
Adds an option in the overflow menu to remove titles from Continue Watching.
Remove Premium Upsell
Removes Premium subscription prompts and verification upsell surfaces across the app.
Remove server change delay
Removes the wait period and cooldown between server changes on free plans.

Automatically dismisses NSFW community warnings and notification suggestion dialogs.
Remove View Count
Removes public tweet view counters across timelines and tweet detail views.
Remove viewer discretion dialog
Suppresses content advisory and viewer discretion warnings when playing age-restricted songs.
Replay slower button
Adds options to rewind and play part of the video at a slower speed, with a player button or by swiping left on the video.
Return YouTube Dislike
Displays public dislike counts on music videos and tracks.
Return YouTube Username
Adds an option to show channel names instead of handles in comments, below the video title and in Shorts.
Reverse playlist autoplay
Adds an option to autoplay playlists in reverse order, from the last video to the first.
Rounded keycaps & shapes
Enables Material 3 Belka rounded pill keycaps, extra theme editor key shapes, and persistent preference.
Sanitize Reddit sharing links
Removes tracking query parameters from shared links.
Sanitize share links
Strips tracking parameters (igsh, utm, fbclid) from shared URLs.
Sanitize sharing links
Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
Save document as PDF
Saves multi-page documents and carousels as a unified PDF in Downloads.
Scan text (Camera OCR)
Unlocks the Camera OCR scan text viewfinder in the Gboard toolbar to extract physical text.
Scrobbling
Adds scrobbler integration to sync played tracks with Last.fm and ListenBrainz profiles.
Search hidden profiles
Allows searching and opening hidden or NSFW Reddit user profiles.
Seekbar
Adds options to disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar,
Seekbar color
Hide or set a custom seekbar color.
Seekbar thumbnail preview
Adds an option to restore the seekbar thumbnail preview.

Sends GIFs committed from the keyboard\'s GIF picker as animated media in DMs, instead of showing "Tap the sticker icon to find and send GIFs".
Show free server locations
Allows users on free tier plans to browse, search, and connect directly to free server locations/countries instead of random assignment.
Show Sensitive Media
Displays sensitive media directly without requiring tap to reveal.
Show unplayable songs
Forces Spotify\'s own "Show unplayable songs" setting on, so tracks that
Show view count
Adds an option to show post view counts.
Sign-to-Text (Signboard ASL)
Enables Sign-to-Text camera translation for American Sign Language.
Signature verification bypass
Bypasses internal signature checks for Google Play services and offline speech/AI models.
Skip live Shorts
Automatically skips live streams that appear in the Shorts feed.
Skip silence
Adds an option to detect and skip silent gaps between songs.
Smart auto-correction & fast learning
Enhances auto-correction accuracy, enables reverting auto-corrected words on backspace, and optimizes user history learning.
Smart Compose autocompletion
Enables in-line predictive text completion, ghost text, and client-side inline suggestions across all input fields.
Sonos cast
Adds direct discovery and streaming to local Sonos speakers and devices.
SoundProof
Adds SoundProof AI blocker to detect and mute AI-generated tracks.
Split keyboard on all devices
Enables split keyboard layout mode across phones, foldables, and tablets.

Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.

Forces WarpPlusState to UNLIMITED on every AccountData instance in the 1.1.1.1 user interface.

Starts videos in the feed and reels with sound automatically, respecting phone ringer and media volume.

Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit\'s native guest browsing mode.

Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, preventing stories from auto-advancing.
Suppress calibration prompts
Suppresses repetitive compass figure-8 calibration popups and location accuracy alert dialogs.
Swipe between feeds

Swipe controls
Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.
Swipe up for comments
Allows swiping up on media in the media viewer to open comments instead of the next video.
Tap to hide in viewers
Tap a video or document in full screen to hide captions and buttons.

Fixes paste shortcuts in raw terminal input fields (Termux) and automatically selects all text before copy/cut when nothing is selected.
textComponentPatch

Makes the system navigation bar fully transparent.

Undo action controls
Enables proactive 1-tap Undo buttons in the suggestion strip after text replacements and autocorrection.

Unlock connection preferences
Unlocks default connection protocol (WireGuard, OpenVPN, Stealth) and profile settings on free plans.
Unlock Premium
Enables local Reddit Premium UI perks (custom app icons, premium styling, avatar styling). Server-side perks cannot be unlocked.

Video effects
Adds shader and post-processing video effects options and controls.
Video quality

VideoId
